scope: Two original short AQA AS first-mock Physics history-of-light evidence cards; does not claim whole Waves coverage.

cards.subject: Physics
cards.front: What feature of Young's double-slit pattern supports a wave model of light?
cards.back: Alternating bright and dark interference fringes.
accept: An interference pattern of alternating bright and dark bands.
Fringes caused by constructive and destructive interference.
reject: Only a single uniformly bright band is formed.
It shows electrons are emitted from the surface of a metal.
Young's experiment disproved all wave properties of light.

cards.subject: Physics
cards.front: Which later effect challenged a purely classical-wave explanation of light?
accept: Emission of electrons from a metal above a threshold light frequency.
reject: The refraction of light through a prism.
Sound waves forming stationary waves on a string.
